Name: Pul, King of Assyria
Summary: King of Assyria stirred up by God to carry away the Reubenites, Gadites, and half tribe of Manasseh.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:26: King of Assyria stirred up by God to carry away the Reubenites, Gadites, and half tribe of Manasseh.
LifeLesson: The mention of Pul in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
